description: TensorFlow calculates with tensors and trains models. Learn small numeric operations, gradients and a first Keras model while keeping training demonstrations separate from proven results. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
learningObjectives: Practise gradients describe a local change
Practise a dense layer combines inputs
